allowed_claims: can discuss workflow fit at a general level

caller_identity.relationship_to_offer: calling about a synthetic operations workflow review

integration_risk.causal_story: If integration or security fit is uncertain, a technical human should review before any implementation claim is made.
integration_risk.definition: Determine whether integration or security review is the current blocker.
diagnostic_questions: Is integration or security review the main thing a technical specialist should look at?
integration_risk.label: integration risk
integration_risk.value_bridge: A technical fit review can check integration and security boundaries without making unverified claims.

manual_work.causal_story: If manual work stays unresolved, the team may keep losing time to repeated operational steps.
manual_work.definition: Determine whether manual workflow load is a current operations pain.
diagnostic_questions: Where does the current process still depend on manual work?
evidence_negative: manual work is not a problem
manual_work.label: manual work
manual_work.value_bridge: A human operations review can map the manual workload before discussing fit.

visibility_gap.causal_story: If workflow status is hard to see, ownership and handoff decisions may stay unclear.
visibility_gap.definition: Determine whether lack of workflow visibility is a current issue.
diagnostic_questions: Is visibility into workflow status the part creating friction?
visibility_gap.label: visibility gap
visibility_gap.value_bridge: A human fit review can connect the visibility issue to the actual operating workflow.

qualification_goals: route technical and security questions to a human
